SELECT sku.sku, sku.sku_name, sku.spec, sku.unit, unitPrice.unit_price_type, unitPrice.unit_price FROM tb_sku_master sku JOIN tb_unit_price_master unitPrice ON sku.company_code = unitprice.company_code AND sku.sku = unitPrice.sku WHERE sku.sku_type = 'ITEM'
AND unit_price_type = 'SELL_UNIT'
AND unit_price_type = 'BUY_UNIT'
